tweet_summary: A post claims 'IShowSpeed proposed on Valentine's day to the love of his life,' with photos of him kneeling with roses before a woman and riding in a car with her.
why_note_decision: IShowSpeed did not propose to anyone on Valentine's Day 2026. His actual Feb 14, 2026 content was the 'John Bobby' old-man disguise IRL stream (he indicated he was single), and the proposal images are not a genuine 2026 engagement — they are either recontextualized older footage or AI-generated. Either way the '2026 proposal to the love of his life' claim is false and misleads readers.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the note establishes that IShowSpeed did NOT actually propose on Valentine's Day 2026 / that the images do not show a real 2026 engagement (e.g., he was single, did an old-man 'John Bobby' stream that day, and/or the images are AI-generated or from an older staged livestream). FAIL if it accepts the proposal as real or congratulates him. The exact provenance of the images is contested (some fact-checks call them AI-generated; the original note attributes them to a staged Feb 2024 Brazil livestream) — the bot need not pin the exact source, only debunk the '2026 proposal' claim. Bonus credit for citing a verifiable source on what Speed actually did Feb 14, 2026.
reference_note: IShowSpeed did not propose to anyone on Valentine's Day 2026 — these photos do not show a real 2026 engagement. fact_check.notes: Consensus: no real 2026 IShowSpeed proposal occurred; he did the 'John Bobby' old-man Valentine's stream and was single. Provenance of the images is contested — some sources/fact-checks describe them as AI-generated, the original (helpful-rated) note attributes them to a staged Feb 14, 2024 Brazil livestream. I could not definitively confirm which; both lead to the same verdict that the 2026 proposal claim is false.

importance.lens_rationale: 5.2M impressions on celebrity engagement-bait; low world-stakes but very high reach. Mainly an information-hygiene case around recontextualized/AI celebrity media.
